description: Angular M6 benchmark baseline (docs/PLAN-R9-ANGULAR.md M6). Milliseconds, headless Chromium via npm run test:angular; each run writes .cache/angular-bench.json. A: 100 Text Inputs in a reactive form (mount, patchValue all). B: Data Table, 100,000 rows, virtual, auiCell template (mount, scroll to the middle incl. one frame). C: dashboard with 4 charts, 6 stat cards, tabs, 1,000-row paged table (mount). loop.*: average mount+destroy in a loop (A x20, B x5, C x20); retained instances and hosts after GC must be 0.
machine: developer workstation (Windows 11, Node 22.18.0, Chromium from Playwright 1.63)
